column1: # Source-of-truth manifest for third-party software notices.
# One row is required for each license/notice document. A path may be quoted.
# Fields may not contain commas or newlines; embedded CSV quoting is not supported.
# Use SPDX license identifiers and pin source_url to the dependency commit when possible.
# System-installed Protocol Buffers uses a tracked copy of its upstream license text.
# NOTE: resources/assets has no license/notice file at the pinned commit. Its terms
# must be confirmed separately; do not infer a license from this software manifest.
# Transitive dependencies (including Bazel-fetched repositories) are not auto-discovered.
